name: timetable-and-etas
eval: (async()=>{const A=__grahan,B=A.bot,G=A.game;const ok=(c,m)=>{ if(!c) throw new Error('ASSERT '+m); };const wait=(ms)=>new Promise((r)=>setTimeout(r,ms));A.setTime(10); A.step(1); const s = A.state().transit; const eta = (id, d) => G.transit.nextArrival(id, d).eta; const day = { served: s.served, activeTrains: s.trains.filter((t) => t.active).length, sionEast: R(eta('sion', 'east')), sionWest: R(eta('sion', 'west')) }; ok(day.served === 3 && day.activeTrains === 3, 'three trains run by day'); ok(isFinite(eta('sion', 'east')) && isFinite(eta('sion', 'west')) && eta('sion', 'east') < 160, 'every station has an ETA both ways, a train within a few minutes: ' + eta('sion', 'east')); A.setTime(23); A.step(0.2); const night = A.state().transit.served; A.setTime(2); A.step(0.2); const dead = A.state().transit.served; A.setTime(5); A.step(0.2); const dawn = A.state().transit.served; A.setTime(10); A.step(0.2); ok(night === 1 && dead === 0 && dawn === 1, 'sparser at night (1), none from 01:00 to 04:00 (0), one again before dawn: ' + [night, dead, dawn]); return { day, night, dead, dawn, etas: s.stations.map((x) => [x.id, x.eta.east, x.eta.west]) }; function R(v) { return Math.round(v * 10) / 10; }})()

name: recharge-sunlit-vs-shaded-vs-night
eval: (async()=>{const A=__grahan,B=A.bot,G=A.game;const ok=(c,m)=>{ if(!c) throw new Error('ASSERT '+m); };const wait=(ms)=>new Promise((r)=>setTimeout(r,ms));const out = {}; for (const h of [11, 23]) { A.setTime(h); B.d.step(0.3); for (const l of G.lifts.lifts) { l.goTo(l.stops[0].id); l.charge = 0; } B.d.step(20); out[h] = Object.fromEntries(G.lifts.lifts.map((l) => [l.id, +l.charge.toFixed(1)])); } const lit = out[11]['lift-canyon'], shaded = out[11]['lift-g1-skywalk'], night = out[23]['lift-canyon']; ok(lit > 12 && shaded < lit / 2.5 && night < 1, 'fast by day when lit (' + lit + '), slow when shaded (' + shaded + '), hardly any at night (' + night + ')'); A.setTime(10); return out;})()

name: express-lift-g-to-l3
eval: (async()=>{const A=__grahan,B=A.bot,G=A.game;const ok=(c,m)=>{ if(!c) throw new Error('ASSERT '+m); };const wait=(ms)=>new Promise((r)=>setTimeout(r,ms));A.setTime(10); A.set('rays', 12); const L = G.lifts.get('lift-wadala-express-s'); L.goTo('bottom'); L.charge = 90; B.d.step(1); A.teleport(97, 0.05, -22, 0); A.look(-90, 0); B.d.step(0.4); { let k = 0; while (G.modal && k++ < 300) B.d.step(0.1); } B.d.run('KeyE', 0.1); B.d.step(0.3); const rays0 = A.state().rays; const cost = 38 * 1.5; B.d.step(11); const s = A.state(); ok(s.level === 'L3' && s.pos.y > 37.9, 'the express lift goes straight from the street to the Upper Decks: ' + s.level); ok(Math.abs(90 - cost - L.charge) < 25, 'a 38 m ride costs about 57% of the cell: ' + L.charge); return { level: s.level, charge: L.chargePct };})()

name: draw-calls-worst-case
eval: (async()=>{const A=__grahan,B=A.bot,G=A.game;const ok=(c,m)=>{ if(!c) throw new Error('ASSERT '+m); };const wait=(ms)=>new Promise((r)=>setTimeout(r,ms));A.set('view', 'third'); A.do('setuFind'); A.do('jeetuJoin'); A.set('hazards', true); A.do('hazardsClear'); A.set('invulnerable', true); A.setTime(10); const rows = []; let max = 0; const measure = async (label) => { B.d.step(1.2); G.render(); G.render(); const c = G.renderStats().calls; rows.push([label, c]); max = Math.max(max, c); }; /* a crowded station with a train standing and another arriving */ A.teleport(-45, 0.5, -67.6, 0); A.look(-90, -6); A.do('setuTeleportToPlayer', 3); const w = A.do('transitWait', 'sion', 'east', 300); ok(w, 'a train at Sion'); await measure('Sion platform, train standing'); A.look(-110, -4); await measure('Sion platform, looking down the line'); A.teleport(-45, 0.5, -52.4, 0); A.look(-150, -6); A.do('setuTeleportToPlayer', 3); await measure('Sion south platform, an arriving train'); A.teleport(135, 0.5, -52.4, 0); A.look(-90, -6); A.do('setuTeleportToPlayer', 3); await measure('Sewri'); A.teleport(-45, 0, -30, 0); A.look(-90, 0); A.do('setuTeleportToPlayer', 3); await measure('the collapse crowd'); A.teleport(10, 12, -26, 0); A.look(90, 0); A.do('setuTeleportToPlayer', 3); await measure('the bazaar'); A.teleport(-105, 0, -80, 0); A.look(0, 0); A.do('setuTeleportToPlayer', 3); await measure('Dharavi'); A.teleport(-15, 0, -50, 0); A.look(0, 0); A.do('setuTeleportToPlayer', 3); await measure('Sion crossing, booms down maybe'); /* riding, in third person */ A.teleport(-45, 0.5, -67.6, 0); A.do('setuTeleportToPlayer', 3); const w2 = A.do('transitWait', 'sion', 'east', 300); A.do('transitBoard', 'sion'); A.look(-90, -8); B.d.step(5); await measure('riding, third person'); A.set('view', 'first'); ok(max <= 150, 'the draw-call budget (about 150) holds at the worst case in third person: ' + max); return { max, rows, drawn: A.state().crowds.drawn };})()
